title: The bill and the plan
learning_goal: See the compute bill, its uncertainty and what it leaves out, then the 36-month plan on one page, with its named risks and the one it cannot rate.
takeaway: The bill is estimated with at least a factor-two uncertainty, and every estimate will be replaced by a measured number; the plan is a proposal whose last months are not yet funded.
notes: Extension module, extended cut only, inserted after X6 (unit anchor: after X6's last scene; CONTRACT P1), so it closes the extended cut's L5 finale before ch10.Q, ch10q and ch11. Three scenes: X5.5 PENDING (no GPU cost measured), X5.6 READY, and a NEW question card X5b.Q (category logistics, ask S. Cheng / D. Lucor / C. Nore): who funds the months of a fall-2027 thesis that fall after MilaDy's nominal end. The plan itself lists it as 'a question to ask the supervisors before committing' (T:1000) and no other card asks it. Registers: X5.5 BLUEPRINT (T3 ink change in its 1.6-s lead-in; X6.6 is NIGHT per the outline), X5.6 back to NIGHT (T3 in its 1.2-s lead-in), X5b.Q NIGHT. Modules are asides: no chapter card; module tag lower-third and rail at L5 in X5.5's lead-in. Badges: X5.5 CONJECTURE low (the bet), X5.6 PLANNED (note: independent proposal), none on the card. CHANGES AGAINST THE OUTLINE, to review. (1) X5.5 target 30 -> 40 s (result 40 s, unchanged): the plan, its anchor, the bet, the confidence and the ask need about 86 words. Module 1:15 -> 1:35 with the 10-s card. (2) X5.5's ASK: the plan's H4 keeps the reference simulations of tiers 2-4 (≈ 2 × 10⁴ CPU hours and more) on CPUs outside the GPU bill, whereas the configured palier2_tg3d campaign asks for one GPU per simulation (palier2_tg3d.yaml:51) and the rental plan runs them on a GPU: whose machines run them decides what the bill counts. Distinct from X5.3's seat ASK (where the first campaign runs). (3) X5.6: the site figure's axis colours are not reused (key clash), the risk cards link back to X5.5, X3.5 and X4.4 (the module ties the three L5 asides together), and the funding risk sets up the card. The merged score 4.45 (S:451) is not shown: the site calls it 'favorable by construction'. (4) NEW card X5b.Q, as above. PLACEMENT: in the extended cut X5b.Q is followed directly by ch10.Q (Taylor-Green forcing) and then ch10q, which gathers the questions: two cards back to back. The question register may fold X5b.Q into ch10q (category logistics) or keep it here; the card stands on its own either way. n is null until the register numbers it. DATA. X5.5 reads data/x5_compute_bill.json (tools/data_cloud.py bill); the plan's numbers are planned values carried in entry.params with their source lines (T:965-972), as X5a does for C:153; if CONTRACT §5 is read strictly, tools/data_existing.py can write data/X5b_plan_budget.json with the same content (tiers, reserve, anchor, CPU hours) and the scene reads it instead. X5.6 has no data file: its months, scores and ratings are planned values and the author's judgments, carried in entry.params with sources (same remark: a 'site_facts' file would make them traceable through the source lower-third). REQUESTS (foundation engineer B, tools/data_cloud.py conv_bill). (a) The plan's hours are A100-class TRAINING hours per tier (T:965-972) and its simulations are CPU hours outside that bill (H4); the converter sums simulation wall time per campaign and compares it with a {campaign: hours} JSON 'transcribed from T:955-974', which the thesis does not give per campaign: the plan JSON must hold like-for-like expectations at the configured scale (12 runs × 40 snapshots, an MLP on Fourier modes, not the planned 20 points × 5000 snapshots and latent models), and GPU classes must be converted (the rental plan uses an L4, the plan counts A100 hours), otherwise the ratio is meaningless and the verdict trivially 'not met'; (b) separate training runs (MLflow / catalog models) from simulations, so that the measured bar is comparable with the plan bar and the CPU side bar can be filled; (c) numeric 'ratio' and 'measured_hours' in fields (say() writes digit strings such as '1.5', which the narration would read as digits) and the booleans met / not_met / inconclusive. (d) GPU sharing: wall_time_s × max(n_gpus, 1) counts GPU hours only when each simulation had its own GPU (C:141); on a VM, make sweep runs up to resources.max_parallel simulations on one GPU (12 for palier2_tg3d.yaml:55), so the converter must divide by the number of simulations sharing a card, or the measured bar overstates the bill up to twelvefold. (e) fields.a100_factor: the GPU-class conversion factor actually applied (a number), absent when none was applied; the result narration branches on it (r2b / r2c), so it never claims a conversion the converter did not make. The placeholders now read {{ratio:1}} and {{measured_hours:0}}: one decimal, or whole hours, whether the field arrives as a number or a string. SYMBOLS: none of the sheet's physics symbols in the narration; 'graphics-card hours' and 'processor hours' in narration (as ch10 says 'graphics card'), 'GPU h' and 'CPU h' on screen. LEXICON: 'MilaDy' pinned; no new entry. MUSIC: none (L5). PACE: 125-130 effective words per minute of target_s; estimates with the assembler formula (146 raw words per minute, 0.9 s per paragraph break, holds, lead-in, tail). REVIEW 2026-11-08 (adversarial script review): changes and evidence in script/_review/X3b-X4b-X5b.md.

Hard constraints, crowd laws, thresholds and reversals, from three dials to a precessing cylinder.

question.en: A thesis from fall 2027 would end after MilaDy's *nominal end*: who funds its *last months*?
question.say: A thesis starting in fall twenty twenty-seven would end after MilaDy's nominal end: who funds its last months?
question.fr: Une thèse commencée à l'automne 2027 finirait après la *fin nominale* de MilaDy : qui finance ses *derniers mois* ?
question.why: MilaDy runs 48 months from January 2026; a 36-month thesis from fall 2027 ends in fall 2030. The plan rates this risk's impact high and leaves its probability 'to be clarified'.
question.unblocks: Logistics: whether the 36-month plan stands as drawn or must be compressed (tier 4 is the first to go), and the commitment to the thesis itself.
question.why_fr: MilaDy dure 48 mois à partir de janvier 2026 ; une thèse de 36 mois commencée à l'automne 2027 finit à l'automne 2030. Le plan juge l'impact de ce risque élevé et laisse sa probabilité « à clarifier ».
question.unblocks_fr: Logistique : le plan de 36 mois tient-il tel quel ou faut-il le resserrer (le palier 4 tombe en premier), et l'engagement dans la thèse lui-même.
question.ask_who: S. Cheng / D. Lucor / C. Nore
